sources.snippet: Model names are specified in the format x_y_z, where x is the model architecture, y is the fraction of the combined video dataset used for self-supervised pretraining, and z is the seed: x can be one of vits14, vitb14, vitl14, vith14, vith14@448, vith14@476 y can be one of 1.0, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001 z can be one of 1, 2, 3
